style.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF for packshots, rounded-corner mist grey #EDEDF2 panels for detail and multi-view screens, deep navy #232C43 dark ground for fill and fabric macro screens, warm amber #F0A81C title and spec bands, charcoal #3A3A3C for type
style.iconSystem: thin-line circular outline badges with a single small amber #F0A81C glyph, one line weight, no filled or 3D icons
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio light with a gentle front or front-left key plus fill and a soft contact shadow that grounds the garment; dark-ground macro screens use raking side light at a low 45-degree angle with a soft back-glow; scene shots use flat overcast winter daylight at 5400K
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm autumn-winter menswear down-jacket ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, mist grey panels #EDEDF2, deep navy dark ground #232C43 and one warm amber accent #F0A81C with charcoal #3A3A3C type; warm tone; one modern geometric sans-serif family, bold headline type in #3A3A3C and white labels on amber bands, Chinese words only inside 「」; rounded-corner mist grey detail panels and deep navy macro grounds; bright soft studio light with a gentle front or front-left key, soft contact shadow, and raking side light on dark-ground macros; thin-line circular outline badges with one small amber glyph; stable slight 3/4 hero product scale, centered; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: the garment is always the single hero subject at a stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale, centered and never clipped; worn by a generic male model cropped at the neck or below the chin, or laid flat; no prop ever covers the garment
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless studio sweep, matte mist grey board #EDEDF2 inside detail tiles, deep navy fabric ground #232C43 for macros, blurred cold-season pavement for street scenes
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family only, bold headline type in #3A3A3C and white labels on amber #F0A81C bands, Chinese words allowed only inside 「」
